title: Graph traversal
tests_run: python -m pytest tests/intelligence/test_graph_store.py tests/intelligence/test_graph_builder.py tests/intelligence/test_graph_traversal.py tests/intelligence/test_boundaries.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
tests_passed: 758 full CRIBA tests passed; 1 pre-existing dependency deprecation warning
decisions: GraphTraversal uses directed outgoing edges while preserving the store's deterministic relation order.
BFS is bounded by an explicit non-negative max_depth and returns each node once.
shortest_path delegates to the canonical SQLiteKnowledgeGraphStore implementation rather than duplicating path logic.
risks: BFS returns the start id even when that id is absent from the store; existence validation remains a caller/store concern.
Traversal currently exposes BFS and shortest path only; weighted or bidirectional traversal is outside P06-T03.
follow_up: BF-P00-T06 golden validation in an isolated copy; do not overwrite live tracked artifacts
